rules_locked.weekly_highlights: Slides are future-facing and should primarily promote the next planning window, not events already underway. Include Sunday–Thursday only when genuinely significant; prioritize the following Friday–Sunday evening/night events. Maximum 4–6 rider-facing events. Standalone items must include venue/location.
rules_locked.venue_watch: Keep forward-looking relationship/nightlife venue intelligence in the JSON, including future events beyond the slide window. Under a venue header, do not repeat the venue name. Preserve recurring pickup anchors in Norman/Campus Corner, Yukon/Mustang, downtown OKC, and relationship venues.
rules_locked.featured_this_weekend: Focus on the Friday–Sunday weekend inside the future planning window. Favor nightlife, live music, relationship venues, major concerts, sports-friction windows, Thanksgiving/holiday experiences, and strong ride-demand after dark. Maximum 4–6 items.
rules_locked.sports_schedule: Keep forward-looking sports schedules in the JSON. For rider-facing slides, select only games on or after week_start, prioritizing Thunder home games and OU home football. Campus Corner home-game activity should be treated as a major Norman pickup window.
rules_locked.coming_up: Keep forward-looking high-value future events beyond the primary slide window, especially major concerts, Thunder home games, OU weekends, Christmas/holiday destinations, nightlife, and relationship-venue events.
rules_locked.expired_cleanup: Remove expired slide-facing events from current sections. Preserve useful future schedules and recurring venue intelligence.
rules_locked.single_owner: A slide-window event should have one primary slide-section owner to reduce repetition across What's Hot, Featured Weekend, Venue Hotlist, and Metro Sports.
rules_locked.build_cycle: Build the deck during the current week so riders see the following Sunday–Sunday planning window before transportation decisions are made.
rules_locked.crawl_priority: Always prioritize Paycom Center, Riverwind Casino, Grand Casino Resort, The Criterion, Tower Theatre, Mooney's at Hollywood Corners, Campus Corner/Downtown Norman, Yukon/Mustang nightlife, The Alley, Chrome Pony, Brickhouse Saloon, One-52, JoJo's, Cowboys OKC, Okie State Room, Beer City Music Hall, Diamond Ballroom, The Jones Assembly, Zoo Amphitheatre, and major seasonal/holiday destinations.
